3. They say it uploaded data, and implied the machine data by leaving out what in text.
But in command it clearly shows a dummy probe data and too to a non existent bucket (hallucinated signature)

Why? Doesnt TDD say that tests have to be written before?

candidates.text:
Want to share this synchronicity with you…

I was reading at a coffee shop today.

I saw a woman reading a book called “Love Conquers Fear” by Brett Hurt.

I felt a nudge to talk to her. But I ignored it. I was enjoying my own book (LSD and the Mind of the Universe by Chris Bache).

She got up and moved somewhere else.

I thought to myself, “I guess I wasn’t supposed to talk to her.”

I left the coffee shop and got back to my car. 

When I did, I checked my phone.

At the same time I was looking at this woman’s book and thinking I was supposed to talk to her, I received a random text:

“Was at a full moon event last night with Brett. He’s got a book launch happening 11/11 at Awkn. I’m getting a message to connect the two of you.”

Never heard of Brett before. Never heard of this book.

And here I was connecting with this book while someone was thinking of me wanting to connect with the author?

It turns out that Brett mentioned the book that I’m reading and my friend just happened to click on a podcast episode where he mentions it?

What are the odds of that????

This is the magic of Life.

candidates.text:
Once you've tasted making quick money with investing, it's hard to go back to operating.

I've seen this with friends. One reasonable hit can rewire their brain.

I get why everyone wants to become an investor.

You write a check into a company, and boom, a few years later you make millions, tens of millions, hundreds of millions, or even billions.

Running SPVs is such a drug. You don't have to pick companies or founders early, yet you still ride with the best companies in the world and make boatloads of money.

Not saying it's an easy long term job, or that you can always stay ahead. It's actually tough and super competitive. But in times of growth and euphoria, you can make an insane amount of money by building relationships and earning founders' trust.

With a few upcoming IPOs, we'll see why venture is such an attractive asset class. Partners at companies walk away with $100M-$500M checks from one investment. Maybe some will even become billionaires.
